Create private, high-throughput connections between Azure datacenters and your existing on-premises or hybrid infrastructure. ExpressRoute connections don’t use the public Internet, so they offer more reliability, faster speeds, lower latencies, and higher security than regular connections. We have a 99.9% SLA in place for connection uptime, and two new bandwidth tiers for Exchange Providers: 200 Mbps and 500 Mbps in addition to 1 Gbps and 10 Gbps tiers. ExpressRoute service will be available in Silicon Valley, Washington DC and London through AT&T NetBond, Equinix, Level3 Communications, British Telecom and Verizon. We are also pleased to announce strategic partnerships with TeleCity Group and SingTel for Europe and APAC markets. Learn more about ExpressRoute .

If you were already using the preview version of ExpressRoute, you can keep using it at preview pricing rates until July 1st, 2014. Or, choose a lower connection speed and pay the General Availability rate. The ExpressRoute Pricing details page has a comprehensive look at pricing. If you want to disable ExpressRoute for your account, sign into the Azure Management Portal .
